documentation.description: Moves long literals (longer than *string-max-size*) from the triplestore into string files under ./data/authorization/strings, replacing them by abbreviation URIs. Run this after lowering *string-max-size*. Settings are read from ./config/authorization/config.lisp.

Inlines string files whose content is short enough (<= *string-max-size*) from ./data/authorization/strings back into the triplestore as literals, and reports on the rest. Run this after raising *string-max-size*. Settings are read from ./config/authorization/config.lisp.
